answer_1.quote: The out-of-domain sentences are produced by nine machine translation and paraphrase generation models.
answer_1.outputs: Generated sentences used as out-of-domain data in RuCoLA.

answer_3.quote: We obtain the PenLP measure for each sentence by computing its log-probability from the ruGPT3-medium model.

answer_4.quote: The out-of-domain sentences undergo a two-stage annotation procedure on Toloka, a crowdsourcing platform for data labeling... We collect the majority vote labels via a dynamic overlap from three to five workers after filtering them by response time and performance on control tasks.
answer_4.guideline: Workers judge whether a given sentence is acceptable or not; instructions include explanations of labels and examples.
